from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NonCurrentAssetsEntry(BaseModel):
    """Non-current assets total reported in one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if available")
    non_current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="Total non-current assets value")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    non_current_assets_entries: list[NonCurrentAssetsEntry]
